copy.curiosityHook: When multiple patients describe eerily similar nighttime traumas, can their testimony explain decades of vanished townsfolk?
copy.description: In Nome, Alaska, decades of unsolved disappearances puzzle authorities. While treating local patients, psychologist Dr. Abigail Tyler uncovers disturbing evidence that connects the missing to extraterrestrial abductions.
copy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful mystery demanding focused attention, best experienced alone in the dark.
copy.whyWatch: Olatunde Osunsanmi weaves clinical therapy sessions with eerie sci-fi mystery, delivering a tense, unsettling thriller that reframes real-world missing-persons cases.

allowedMaterial: Setting in Nome, Alaska with history of unexplained disappearances
Dr. Abigail Tyler's profession as a psychologist treating local patients
Discovery of evidence pointing to alien abductions
Genre elements of mystery, thriller, and science fiction
excludedMaterial: Patient fates or specific session revelations beyond initial setup
Authenticity debates, mockumentary framing, or hoax outcomes
